relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Cyclooxygenase-2 enzyme (COX-2) induces the formation of PGE2 and pancreatic inflammation may be potentially dependent on COX-2 (6).

relationships.subject: Indomethacin
relationships.evidence_quote: a mean decrease was seen in both plasma and saliva PGE2 levels with administration of indomethacin, whereas a mean increase was seen with placebo

key_findings: Indomethacin did not significantly differ from placebo in change of pancreatic fluid PGE2 (-457.7 vs -840.4 pg/mL, P=0.25)
Indomethacin was safe; pain interference improvement trended toward significance (P=0.058)
